prompts.player: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet for STARFALL, an ORIGINAL 1990s NEOGEO-inspired top-down space shoot-em-up. Generate a transparent PNG asset sheet, no labels, no lines, no background, no shadow. SINGLE ROW OF EXACTLY THREE spacecraft poses, equal spaced, with generous transparent gutter. Same small heroic fighter in every pose, nose UP, identical proportions, identical nose y position and fuselage x centers, fixed scale. Silhouette: long spear nose, angular swept wings, paired engines; pearl metal, deep navy shadows, cyan armor accents, tiny amber cockpit. Detailed shaded machinery in crisp chunky pixel clusters, a beautiful arcade sprite rather than smooth illustration. Left pose: subtle axial roll bank LEFT ~18 degrees; left wing foreshortened and dark, right wing broad top visible. Middle: perfectly symmetric level flight. Right pose: subtle axial roll bank RIGHT ~18 degrees; right wing foreshortened and dark, left wing broad top visible. ALL noses still point exactly UP; banking must redraw perspective of wings and show ship sides, not rotate the sprite in the image plane. Clear actual distinct bank poses, modest banking, same identity, stable registration. No engine flames on this sheet: dark engine nozzles visible at bottom. Each sprite fits generous equal 1/3-width cell, centered x and y. Render as pixel art with square pixels, sharp stepped outlines, no bloom, no blur, no antialias, no text. Logical design around 34x44 pixels each, faithfully enlarged with nearest-neighbor appearance. Transparent background truly alpha.
prompts.exhaust: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG animation asset for an original NEOGEO-inspired pixel-art spaceship game STARFALL. ONE ROW EXACTLY THREE SEPARATE frames of a SINGLE slender cyan-blue rocket exhaust plume, all pointing DOWN, equal-spaced generous transparent gutters. No spacecraft, no engine nozzles: ONLY exhaust flame. Top attachment point same location in all cells. First flame short, second medium, third long, distinct fluctuating zigzag silhouette. Bright icy white 2-pixel core near top transitioning aqua to saturated azure outer edge to dark blue tip. Hard chunky pixel clusters; logical sprite about 7x19 pixels enlarged sharply; no smooth brushwork, no haze, no antialiased edges, no bloom. Detached transparent flame assets, never a black background. No text, no dividers. These frames will attach beneath two nozzles on a top-down fighter and play at 80ms/frame.
prompts.enemy: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent game sprite. ORIGINAL NEOGEO-inspired top-down arcade space shooter STARFALL. A hostile industrial interceptor drone, nose pointing DOWN toward bottom of image. Broad arrowhead shape with two thick red-copper armored shoulder pods, a menacing hot coral red triangular sensor at its forward lower tip, dark steel central machine spine and two small side guns. Readable powerful silhouette, around 40x34 logical pixels enlarged sharply with square pixel clusters; rich arcade mechanical highlights, navy near-black shadows, warm copper/red armor, gold hazard details. TRUE TOP DOWN orthographic camera, not isometric, not a side view. Shape distinct from player's long white cyan fighter. Compact detailed mechanical pixel sprite, no text, no explosion, no engine flame, no environment, no floor, no cast shadow, no bloom, no blur. Center the one complete ship with generous transparent padding. Genuine alpha background.
prompts.explosion: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: animated explosion sprite sheet for original NEOGEO-inspired pixel arcade shooter STARFALL. TRUE ALPHA transparent background. EXACTLY SIX frames in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid, read left to right then next row. Each equal-size cell has the same central anchor point and ample empty gutter; no overlap. Frame 1 a tiny white-yellow starburst; frame 2 expanded spiky yellow blast with orange edge; frame 3 maximum brilliant yellow and orange round billowing lobes with white center; frame 4 orange fireball with dark red separating gaps; frame 5 several smaller detached orange ember clumps and dark red smoke; frame 6 just sparse dim dark red ember puffs. Keep frame 1 and frame 6 small; biggest third frame fills only 75% of cell. Sharp chunky squared pixel clusters, classic beautifully shaded 16-bit arcade explosion animation, handmade sprite appearance, no photorealism, no smooth particles, no soft blur, no glow outside sprite, no text, no grid lines. Logical each cell 48x48 pixels enlarged sharply. Whole six-frame layout visible, each frame fully separate on transparent.
prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-screen 16:9 background art for original NEOGEO-inspired top-down arcade space shooter STARFALL, stage one 'Orbital Breakwater'. Beautiful detailed 1990s 16-bit arcade pixel art: orbital industrial docks in cobalt planetary orbit. Wide landscape composition, 16:9. The LEFT and RIGHT OUTER edges show heavy top-down navy steel docking gantries, rivets, tiny amber hazard lamps, cargo machinery, dark teal armor panels and sparse copper warning stripes. Center 65% of image is open quiet deep blue outer space, suitable for clear combat sprites and bullets. In upper middle distance a gigantic dark cobalt planet's softly curved atmosphere with restrained pale cyan rim rises beyond the docks, little wisps of blocky blue clouds; tiny sparse stars. Readable rich layered machinery at outer sides, central background remains LOW contrast and much darker than bright white player ships. Camera looking top down at dock platforms, space/planet beyond. Pixelated squared clusters, limited arcade palette and beautiful controlled shading. No ships, no bullets, no explosion, no UI, no text, no logos, no border. Not a poster or illustration with typography. NOT seamless: one composition for slow restrained parallax only, no tile seam claim. Crisp pixel art at logical 480x270 enlarged exactly, no smooth 3D render, no bloom glare, no noisy details in center.
